name: Bittersweet 0.1.0
body:
# Bittersweet 0.1.0

First public test build of Bittersweet for macOS.

- SwiftUI desktop workspace with transport controls, synth controls, and a piano roll.
- Laptop keyboard note input using `A S D F G H J K L ;`.
- Recording into editable note events.
- Timeline playback and offline rendering through the same chiptune synthesis model.
- Project save/load using editable `.bs` files.
- WAV and MP3 export support.

This build is unsigned. macOS may require right-click Open or Privacy & Security approval before launching it.
